# Get the current queue to identify positions of liked songs
current_queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print("Current queue:", current_queue)

# Get liked song IDs
liked_ids = set(song["song_id"] for song in liked_songs)
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_ids)

# Find positions of liked songs in the queue
positions_to_remove = [song["position"] for song in current_queue if song["song_id"] in liked_ids]
print("Positions to remove:", positions_to_remove)

# Remove in descending order to avoid index shifting
for pos in sorted(positions_to_remove, reverse=True):
    result = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(access_token=access_token, position=pos)
